about_short_description.short_description: Mica AI is a Software Development firm offering B2B sales call automation services like analyzation, lead generation and follow-up.

product.name: AI Workflow Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that enables users to create, deploy, and manage automated workflows using natural language without coding.

product.name: Sales Automation Service
product.description: Automates sales outreach, deal prioritization, and follow-ups by analyzing customer interactions and CRM data.

product.name: Marketing Automation Service
product.description: Generates marketing content, runs competitive analyses, and personalizes nurture campaigns using data from multiple customer interaction sources.

product.name: Customer Success Automation Service
product.description: Automates support ticket routing, customer retention management, and follow-ups using data from emails, chats, and CRM systems.

product.name: Legal Operations Automation Service
product.description: Automates contract analysis, compliance checks, and legal document drafting by synthesizing data from emails, CRM, and document repositories.
